title_suffix: Localized execution reports and finalize closeout guidance
summary: This patch release moves the latest localization and closeout behavior fixes onto the 1.2.1 patch line so 1.2.0 remains the base decision-gated workflow release.
improved: Improved finish-plan, AI guidance, packaged change skills, project conventions, and public usage docs so archive-ready changes recommend finalize as the executable closeout step and keep archive --check as preview-only.
fixed: Fixed closeout guidance that could let an AI stop after a passing archive dry run instead of finalizing the completed change.
Fixed generated execution-layer Markdown artifacts so Chinese projects receive localized agent, review, workspace, route, and evidence reports instead of mixed English documents.
docs: Documented that full closeout should continue to ospec finalize after readiness is confirmed, while ospec archive --check remains a dry-run preview.
